name: Marcus Redpath
summary: In Southshore, Marshal Marcus Redpath holds Lordaeron's last southern bastion on the coast. He organizes patrols and bounty contracts against nearby ogres, murlocs, and naga.

sections.title: A Sentinel of Southshore
sections.body: Marshal Marcus Redpath guards Southshore, the Alliance port on the southern coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills. The town endured the fall of Lordaeron's capital and the devastating Scourge invasion. Redpath now leads its defense, protecting the survivors who remain there.

sections.title: Holding the Coast
sections.body: Southshore stands virtually alone against hostile forces pressing in from every side. Marshal Redpath coordinates the defense across the Hillsbrad Foothills and enlists seasoned adventurers to push back the Crushridge ogres advancing from Alterac. He also sends them against dangerous naga and murloc encampments along the coast. The Forsaken occupy the north, and nearby Tarren Mill is heavily fortified. Redpath's vigilance helps keep the Alliance presence in the region from collapsing.

aliases: who is the marshal in southshore
faq.answer: Marcus Redpath is Southshore's marshal and military authority in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He oversees the town's defense against threats from the surrounding wilderness and hostile neighbors.

faq.q: What role did he play in the Second War?
faq.answer: No account of the Second War records Redpath's part in it. Today, Southshore's marshal holds the town against the ogres, murlocs, and naga of the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: What threats does he focus on fighting?
faq.answer: Redpath organizes efforts against local predators and invaders pressing toward Southshore. He issues bounties and missions targeting the Crushridge ogre tribe in the Alterac foothills, coastal murlocs, and raiding naga.

faq.q: Is he related to the Redpaths of Darrowshire?
aliases: is marcus related to joseph redpath
faq.answer: Marcus Redpath shares the surname made famous by Captain Joseph Redpath of Darrowshire in the Eastern Plaguelands. No direct kinship has been established beyond their shared heritage in the Kingdom of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Where can Marcus Redpath be found?
faq.answer: Marshal Redpath is stationed in central Southshore, an Alliance haven on the southern coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you can help Marshal Redpath secure Hillsbrad against encroaching ogres and coastal hazards.
As a human, you see Redpath holding one of humanity's last footholds in Lordaeron. He keeps Southshore standing while the kingdom around it lies in ruin.
